about: Every question this lane's page has asked, open and answered. Added and updated, never removed. Submitted answers are the files in inbox/.

questions.ask: Should ships fly mostly across a plane, or move freely in all three dimensions?
questions.why: This shapes camera behavior and controls. A preference here does not authorize implementation.

questions.ask: Should the main flight view trail your ship or stay at an elevated angle?
questions.why: Both support your flight choice. This chooses the normal view, not whether other views can exist.

questions.ask: What should large battles feel like?
questions.why: I recommend deliberate battles with fast fighters. This leaves room for ship decisions while keeping combat active.

questions.ask: Does that match the kind of battles you have in mind? from round 23
questions.why: My recommendation leaves time for ship decisions while weapons, fighters and missiles keep the battle active.

questions.ask: Which platform should lead the first release?
questions.why: Steam first is my recommendation: fewer simultaneous releases. This preference does not authorize implementation.

questions.ask: Do you already have a registered business, and which country and state would the game business operate from?
questions.why: These facts determine the next setup steps. Entity-specific advice needs your jurisdiction.
